The statewide primaries are on June 9, 2026. Mainers will vote in either Democratic or Republican races for Maine Governor, U.S. Representative, U.S. Senate, State Representative, State Senator, Sheriff, County Commissioner, and more. See more important dates and links to resources at Maine Dems Voter Hub.
